meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes, so let's skip the pleasantries. Who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of a class?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Save it. I asked who decided on the zero.
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero and tell me who entered it.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
We're not on a team. Three questions in, and you haven't answered one. What do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology, and a straight answer on who decided to enter it before anyone contacted me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to know who decided; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never reached it, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed no evidence and never answered her first question.
What cost ground: You met her first question with praise for her and Owen instead of an answer, and flattery never moves her while each dodge made her shorter and harder.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it was entered before anyone called her, then put a dated document tied to Owen's own work in front of her.
